problems: Mirror events are needed in dossiers owned by other eu-11 parts: kingdom-of-mercia (vassal pairs over Kent 764/776/785/796/798/825, East Anglia 794/796/799/825 and Essex 664; gains of Hastings area 771, Sussex 772, London c. 750), kingdom-of-wessex (occupation of Kent 686-687, vassal pair over Sussex c. 686-c. 715, gain of the Isle of Wight 686, gains of Kent, Sussex and Essex 825), kingdom-of-bernicia (the 604 vassal pair over Deira), kingdom-of-northumbria (gain of Deira 612, loss 633, gain 634), viking-settlements (occupation of the Thetford area 865-866, gain of East Anglia 869), danelaw.

Vassal events are written from the vassal's side (counterpart = overlord) in the subordinate's dossier, following reviewer-brief check 3; the schema text reads the counterpart as the vassal. A compiler that applies the schema reading to every dossier would invert them.

Cliopatria rows trimmed or extended: Kent ends 825 not 762, Essex 825 not 665, Sussex 772, Wihtgar 534..686, Deira 450..634; Cliopatria's Mercia row seems to absorb Kent (763) and Sussex (772) as direct territory, which conflicts with Kent staying a vassal state to 825.
Cliopatria's East Anglia shapes include about 2,000 km2 of north Essex; the Essex dossier adds it and the East Anglia dossier removes it, so both must be compiled together.
The 666-749 and 750-825 Essex keyframes and the Kent 763-825 and East Anglia 800-839 keyframes are new periods Cliopatria lacks.
Page budgets were exceeded by one or two pages for Wihtgar (3 pages), Essex (7) and Kent (7) because pages were shared across the batch.
Several capitals are placeholders (the pages name none): Sussex, Wihtgar, Essex, East Anglia; Deira's Malton is 'may have'.
